selection: All six completed #111 second-continuation batches, unfiltered: same measurement as candidates, without telemetry masking, epoch admission or burn-in. Failed attempts excluded.

definitions.delay: Original transport metric: centered +/-600-post-setup-frame minimum; no slope correction. Not #111 excess gauge.
definitions.limits: False-reject control is only the fixed allowance LOO check over six captures; batch drift observed. No population error-rate guarantee, independent validation, renderer or one-way delay claim.

maskedSelection: First-attempt server characterization: #111 admitted epochs, 1 s burn-in and frozen clean telemetry mask. Whole gap/ten-anchor windows must be clean.

viewStrataProvenance.selection: Additive view strata from the same six complete unfiltered captures, replayed from setup. Original summaries, masked/heldout cases and provenance unchanged.
viewStrataProvenance.validation: All nine replayed captures match retained sparse-view per-bin gap counts, active exposure, <=9 ms fractions, whole-window counts and frame totals exactly; peer 6-10 speed/boost/turn fractions match residual replay within 1e-8 percentage points.
